themes: open pack (themes-open): neutral looks only, because this is a public site
notes: A static website (no app, no server, no Electron, no Android), so most modules do not apply and the ones that do are used in their plainest form. appearance: the site vendors themes-open/dist (base.css + engine.global.js) from engine main at 2de8a3c into site/vendor/turbothemes and starts it from site/assets/site.js. There is no React Layout/AppearanceCard and the stock <turbo-themes-picker> is not used: site/assets/picker.js is a small picker built on the engine's headless controller (themes.picker()), with the mock-page preview that themes/docs/PICKER.md section 2a asks for (hover and focus move a miniature of the page, only a click changes the real page). Fonts are 'none' and updates are off (source: false) so the page makes no third-party request; to take newer themes, copy the two files again from a newer engine commit and update `ref`. motion: site/assets/motion.css is the engine's file unchanged (only tk-swap is used; tk-arrive animates max-height, so it is not used on big blocks). logos: branding/logo.json is the bare engine mark (no emblem); the app icons under site/img/apps are copied from each app's own repo (TurboBox: branding/icon-512.png; TurboMC Server: program_info/org.turbonzl.TurboMCServer_256.png; TurboUI has no icon, the page draws a plain tile). release-pipeline: auto-pr.yml is the engine's with the PR text changed, release.yml is only its `release` job (tag vYYYY.M.N; Cloudflare Pages deploys main), check.yml is the site check and also runs on pull requests. guides-and-docs: no in-app guides (docs/guides is not used); docs/development has the rest.
